editorial.precision: Noncombat aid is not restricted to civilian-only aid. A concrete management office is not silently enlarged into an entire government. Questions, treaty duties, opinions, enforcement, actual results and unresolved evidence retain their different scopes.
editorial.originals: Before expansion, all nine original data files and all ten primary HTML files matched HEAD byte for byte. After integration, the nine data files, all27 primary reading bodies and all10 main reading areas still match the captured baseline, except permitted language controls/count metadata.
editorial.limits: AI-assisted writing and independent AI editorial review, not certification by human native speakers. Counts and coverage supplement full reading; they do not establish prose quality.
